summary: Frontend-only re-test of branding update: logo + 'Mayora United Home' rename across every page. All 7 targeted checks pass end-to-end via Playwright on the public URL (mobile viewport 390x844). Login page shows login-logo and heading 'MAYORA UNITED HOME.' (no 'SALES MONITOR'). After sales login (277/12345), the sticky BrandHeader (data-testid=app-header + data-testid=brand containing logo image + 'Mayora United Home' + 'Field Sales App') is visible at top on /dashboard, /penjualan, and /loading (bounding box y=0, h=62). Admin login page shows admin-login-logo; admin panel (password admin123) shows admin-logo image and text 'Mayora United Home · Admin'. Penjualan flow: added 2x DANCARE (370068), review dialog opens with correct '1 item · 2 unit' and total Rp 185.000, Simpan produces receipt-container containing logo image (alt='Mayora United Home'), the text 'Mayora United Home', NO occurrence of 'Sales Monitor', and btn-download-png is present. Stock for DANCARE remained 2/2 after save (no stock mutation). Loading flow: added 2x BURYAM NEW (316857), review dialog correct, save produces loading-receipt-container with the logo image + 'Mayora United Home' text, no 'Sales Monitor', btn-loading-download-png present, and BURYAM stock remained 231/231 after save.
